poses: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: six transparent boss poses for a bright hand-painted children's 2D platformer. ONE 3-column by 2-row grid, 1536x1024 aspect, genuine transparent alpha. Same Cloud King in all six cells: a puffy irregular scalloped sky-blue and ivory cloud body, expressive mischievous eyes, small open mouth with a few triangular teeth, two very long thin blue arms and two long thin legs with little boots, tiny golden crown. Based on a child's cloud monster drawing with long limbs. Friendly playful rather than scary, readable bold plum outlines, watercolor texture, cream highlights and lavender shadows. Full body isolated, no background or ground plane, no text, no grid lines, no labels. Every cell contains exactly one entire pose at same scale with generous transparent margins; hands, limbs, crown, nearby effects entirely inside the cell. Top left idle with arms out; top middle warning inhaling cheeks puffed arms up; top right attack blowing a short small curved wind puff close to mouth, keep effect close. Bottom left tired vulnerable with sleepy face lowered arms; bottom middle hurt recoiling surprised; bottom right defeated sitting with little star above crown. Keep width under 70% and height under 75% of each cell. No fog aura behind sprites, no opaque gradients; clean transparent gutters.
bg: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: wide opaque far background for a children's side-scrolling game Cloud Course. 2048x720 aspect, watercolor storybook painting with soft plum contours and bright cream, periwinkle, peach and sky-blue palette. View across a magical kingdom above clouds: rounded distant floating islands, tiny golden-roof cloud palaces, far rainbow arches, soft layered cumulus clouds, sunshine and small gold star decorations. Panoramic side-on arrangement, upper and middle background detailed, lower quarter quiet pale-blue cloud sea for gameplay overlays. All architecture distant, no foreground platforms or collision surfaces, no characters, no bosses, no text or UI. Warm friendly mood, clear spacious sky, subtle depth.
